content.comment_body: Hello, I'm experiencing an issue with the [product_name] display module. I’ve written a small program that shows alarms on the display, but noticed something odd: When two alarms are triggered at once, only the one with the higher priority appears on the display. Is there a way to change this? The [product_name] software manual mentions you can switch between RUN mode display and message texts using certain buttons, but I’m not sure what that means in practice. Thanks.

A question for you: How do you expect it should operate? If multiple messages are triggered, you could alternate them on the display. Alternatively, one message could appear on the main display and another on the TD module. Another option is to use the ticker text feature. All these approaches require specific programming. As you noted, when more than one message is active, the display shows the one with the highest priority.

Another option is to connect both alarm outputs to an AND block, which then activates an extra message block with a higher priority. Place the output of the message text block on an open connector. With this setup, you can monitor all possible states, depending on how many alarms are active.
Try adjusting the block properties for your message texts.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing uncertainty with how simultaneous alarms are displayed on the [product_name] display module. When two alarms are active, only the highest priority alarm appears. There is confusion about the manual’s instructions regarding switching displays, and users are searching for ways to more flexibly present multiple active alarms.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to see all active alarms at once or switch between them, not just see the highest priority alarm. They also want clearer guidance from the manual and customizable alarm display options.
